response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, leadership in AI-agent infrastructure, and exposure to MCP and cloud tools, but lacks clear evidence of 8+ years focused on production-grade GenAI systems, vector databases, RAG architectures, or enterprise customer-facing technical leadership required for the staff-level role.
strengths: Experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven track record in cloud-native development (AWS CDK, Kubernetes, Docker)
Strong technical leadership and mentoring through workshops and open-source projects
concerns: No explicit mention of vector databases, RAG, or GenAI production systems in past roles
Limited evidence of direct enterprise customer-facing technical discovery or consulting
Education shows BS in CS but no advanced degree, and GenAI experience may not meet 8-year threshold
